content.text: Featured Stories North Carolina Science Festival Science Matters Featured Topic Addressing PFAS Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), known as "forever chemicals," have garnered significant attention due to their widespread use and persistence in the environment. We work with manufacturers, utilities, businesses, and other partners to tackle the PFAS problem through testing, assessment, remediation, and alternatives. Our Experts By The Numbers > 0 % of people in the U.S. have a form of PFAS in their bodies Experts Available for Interview National Security Strategic Account Executive Ivy Estabrooke works at the intersections of national security, health technology, economic development and innovation. She is available for interviews on how RTI combines rigorous scientific methods with practical applications to optimize military performance. PFAS and Water Testing Jennifer Hoponick Redmon is the senior director of environmental health and water quality and the lead author of Hold My Beer: The Linkage between Municipal Water and Brewing. She is dedicated to protecting Americans from chemicals of concern, such as PFAS, lead, and asbestos. Energy Sameer Parvathikar, PhD, RTI's Director of Renewable Energy and Energy Storage, is available for interviews on e-methanol production and other cutting-edge energy technologies. Scientific Impact Eric Otto Johnson, an expert in substance use disorders and multi-omics research, serves in the newly created role of Chief Science Officer. He is available for interviews on translating research into practical solutions. RTI Press® is a global publisher of peer-reviewed, open-access books, reports, and briefs. We publish on a broad range of topics reflecting RTI’s multidisciplinary research, expertise in social and laboratory sciences, and extensive international activities.
